title: What’s mind-blowing is that most of us came to the conclusion that there’s a city in the astral, while being completely unaware that multiple religions mention one existing.
content: It's incredible to think about how many of us have had lucid dreams where we visited places like malls, universities, water parks, casinos, and other locations we’d never seen before—not in real life, movies, or even video games. What’s even more fascinating is that people who’ve experienced these dreams started connecting online, only to realize that some of us were visiting the same locations. This shared experience led to the idea that there is a city in the astral plane. What’s mind-blowing is how many religions mention an actual city in the astral. For instance, the Bible describes the New Jerusalem—a massive city, 1,200 miles long, wide, and high—floating above the Earth. Hindu texts mention the city and called it Devapura: The city of Devas. What makes this so remarkable is that most of us came to this conclusion about an astral city without knowing anything about these religious references. It’s wild how this all lines up.
